note: Photographs #45-49 in Dorin's numbered photo labels (photographer JRH, Nikon D810, September 2019): the SCP showroom in Pimlico, a short-term commercial showroom. Location given only as Pimlico, London. The street seen through the shop window is blurred in #45 and #49.

scp-pimlico-01.alt: Finished showroom room: walls in a deep blue gradient mural that fades to white at the top, around a green velvet sofa under a brass pendant.

scp-pimlico-02.alt: Showroom wall in a gilded marbled wallcovering, a flush door papered in so it almost disappears, beside the shop window.

scp-pimlico-03.alt: The blue gradient mural behind a low walnut sideboard and a linear light, the colour deepening smoothly to the floor.

scp-pimlico-04.alt: Close view of the gilded marbled wallcovering, gold veining over pale grey, crossed by the arc of a floor lamp.

scp-pimlico-05.alt: Panorama of the marbled showroom wall, the gilded pattern running unbroken across the full length of the room.
